reviewer: claude-opus-5 acting as the joshi S5 lane, autonomously, without Ember present
rationale: Reviewed the 49 structural lines above against one live coins-v2 response. The document is a flat JSON object with scalar leaves only: no nested array, no envelope, and therefore no membership or pagination semantics for this route to get wrong. Every field the identity projection reads is present and typed string here (creator, name, program, protocol, quote_mint, symbol, token_program) and the subject field mint is a string. Mutable price and reserve state (market_cap*, *_reserves, total_supply, updated_at, ath_*) is deliberately outside the identity projection and is not promoted by this review. User-supplied fields (description, twitter, image_uri, metadata_uri) are present in the shape but are not projected and carry no trust. KNOWN NARROWNESS, accepted deliberately: this fingerprint pins the exact field set and leaf types of one observed document, so a coin whose optional fields arrive null or absent will produce a different fingerprint and will be refused rather than silently normalized. That refusal is the intended behaviour of this gate, not a defect. This review was made by an agent, not by Ember; it authorises normalisation of provider-asserted identity and topology strings only, and no economic, execution, or on-chain claim whatsoever.
